Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat\(research\): add multi-schedule gas research system

Implements a comprehensive system for running multiple gas schedule
experiments simultaneously and comparing each against baseline execution.

Key features:
- GasSchedule trait abstraction for defining gas pricing experiments
- EIP-2780 schedule: reduced intrinsic gas by transaction category
- CSV pricing schedule: per-opcode/precompile repricing from CSV files
- Multiplier schedule: uniform gas cost multiplication
- ScheduleRegistry for managing multiple schedules
- MultiScheduleInspector for tracking gas deltas in a single execution pass
- MultiScheduleAnalyzer for coordinating comparison and recording divergences
- CLI argument types for easy configuration
- Unified database schema with schedule identification
- 111 tests including integration tests

This enables A/B testing of gas pricing hypotheses without code changes -
just add new CSV files for different pricing experiments.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
